email.subject: A couple quick fixes for Iron Tide Works Fitness
email.body:
Hi Chloe,

I checked out Iron Tide Works Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: there's no way to book a class or session directly from the site, so interested people have to call or message you instead of just signing up, and the page title doesn't say what you do or where, which hurts how you show up when someone in Harbor Falls searches for a gym.

I fix stuff like this for a flat fee. Happy to walk you through what I found in 10 minutes, free, no pitch. Let me know if you're open to it.

Alex
